summary: Alta Equipment Group filed an 8-K on October 2, 2026, announcing that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $625 per share on its 10% Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, equating to $0.625 per outstanding Depositary Share (ALTG PRA). The record date is October 15, 2026, and the payment date is October 30, 2026. No advisor, board recommendation, acquisition, divestiture, or strategic action is disclosed. This is a routine preferred dividend declaration, not a special situation; watch cumulative preferred arrearage and common dividend coverage.
